name: donation-receipt-draft
title: DRAFT donation receipt worksheet
for_each: select id,name from gifts where status='received'

sections.title: Receipt blockers
sections.note: NOT VALID FOR TAX CLAIMS. Resolve every blocker and complete the issuance checks below.
sections.sql: select case when blockers='' then 'Recorded checks clear. Authorised review and issuance still required.' else blockers end as review_required from receipt_checks where id=$1

sections.title: Donation details
sections.sql: select name as draft_reference,donor,currency,amount,gift_date from receipt_checks where id=$1

sections.title: Authorised person
sections.sql: select authorised_name,authorised_role from receipt_checks where id=$1
sections.note: Confirm eligibility and required signature. Non-cash gifts need specialist review.

sections.title: Before issue
sections.sql: select 'Print on official letterhead, allocate a unique receipt number, and obtain the authorised signature for NZ. Mark subsequent copies COPY or REPLACEMENT.' as required_action where $1::uuid is not null

name: pledge-reminder-draft
title: DRAFT pledge reminder for review
for_each: select id,name from pledges where status='open'

sections.title: Remaining promise
sections.note: Internal worksheet only. Check preferences and current donor circumstances before contact.

sections.title: Cash and promises
sections.note: Outstanding promises are separate from received cash. In-kind gifts and void records are excluded from cash totals.

sections.title: Gifts
sections.sql: select g.name,c.name donor,g.currency,g.amount,g.gift_date,g.gift_type,g.status from gifts g join constituents c on c.id=g.constituent_id where g.campaign_id=$1 order by g.gift_date
